# Opal Pettigrew

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c28 P9](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0009)</sub>

## Appearance

Opal possesses a striking, good-looking appearance with light skin, yellow or blonde hair, and fair features.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043)_

## Personality

Opal is superstitious, romantic, and squeamish, often expressing a dread of floating flat while playing dead and admitting to fear in such situations. She is observant and communicative, keeping up with local gossip regarding romance, courting, and marriage.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c28 P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001)_

## Traits

- superstitious  <sub>[v1 c28 P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001)</sub>
- romantic-minded  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015)</sub>
- squeamish  <sub>[v1 c28 P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001)</sub>

## Abilities

- acting in amateur plays and tableaus  <sub>[v1 c28 P0](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0000), [v1 c28 P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011)</sub>

## Goals

- Keep multiple suitors dangling and drive them wild upon reaching adulthood  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015)</sub>

## History

Opal grew up as a student attending school alongside Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke, where they studied English poetry works such as Tennyson's poem on Elaine. On a midsummer afternoon, she joined Isolde and Odette Pullen at the pond beneath Pear Hill to participate in playing and enacting scenes from the poem. While offered the role of Elaine due to her fair skin and bright hair, she declined to play the part of the floating body due to fear of lying flat and acting dead, agreeing instead to take on the role of King Arthur.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001), [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c28 P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v1 c28 P9](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0009), [v1 c28 P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011)_

## Background by volume

- Has a large number of older sisters  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015)</sub>
- Has a sister named Tabitha

## Quotes

> Floating downward does not bother me when two or three of us are occupying the flat and we are able to sit upright. During those times, it is enjoyable. However, lying flat and acting as if I were deceased—that is something I simply could not do. Fear would actually kill me.  <sub>[v1 c28 P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001)</sub>
